verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party Batch API docs let you submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented 50% discount, with a 24-hour to 7-day processing window and no impact on standard rate limits. The billing FAQ lists Batch Processing as a paid-tier benefit. Flex processing is a separate tier priced the same as on-demand, so it does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of batch job submission and of the discount being applied.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq with 50% lower cost, no impact to your standard rate limits, and 24-hour to 7 day processing window.
Process large-scale workloads asynchronously with our Batch API
